cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Pass Me the Authority
cards.instruction: Get someone to transfer authority publicly by naming you as the person who decides what happens next.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Before leaving the meeting, name me as the person who decides.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Furniture announces location, not succession.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: To the room, please. I already agree.
